---
name: Trainer report
about: How a LoRA run went on your songs, voices or sounds
title: "Trainer report: "
labels: trainer
---

The LoRA Trainer is tested on our own songs and voices and held at 90 %: your sets and scenarios are not ours, and your report is how it gets better.

**The set**: what it holds (songs, a voice, a language, an instrument, a style), how many tracks, how long in all, where from.

**The run**: the trainer (the studio's own or AI-Toolkit), the mode (Direct, Full, Melody, separated vocals), the kind (style, voice, language, artist), the rank, the steps or epochs, anything you changed from its defaults.

**The time** the run took, on which card.

**What you heard**: the adapter at which strengths, on which prompts and seeds; what it learned, what it did not, what it broke. A take or two (or their links) help most.

**Anything the Trainer said** (its log, a refusal, an error), as it said it.

**The studio**: its version (☰ → About, or the VERSION file), how it was installed (Pinokio or by hand), the system, the card and its memory.
